skill.name: citation-format

The matched backticks close a Markdown code block and introduce inline style identifiers. They are documentation delimiters, not executable backtick expressions.

content.value_statement: Saved references need consistent formatting and clear metadata checks before use. This skill guides Citation MCP or CLI workflows to format sources, report gaps, and export bibliographies.
actual_capabilities: Format saved references through Citation MCP or CLI using nine documented citation style IDs.
Retrieve paginated formatting results with snapshot consistency checks and a bounded restart after changes.
Check saved citation metadata and report unresolved fields without silently altering source records.
Export a requested bibliography as BibTeX or RIS with the required access permissions.
Present bibliography entries and individual in-text citation examples while identifying document-context limits.
Apply an explicitly requested document style change using version checks and request identifiers.
limitations: Requires access to Citation through MCP or CLI, with appropriate workspace and document permissions.
Checks saved metadata but cannot verify the original publication or establish source accuracy.
Individual in-text examples do not establish final numeric citation order or note numbering.
Does not independently share, publish, or send exports; those actions require explicit authorization and a supported external tool.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Course Bibliography
use_cases.description: Format saved course-paper references in APA or MLA and identify missing metadata before submission.

use_cases.title: Export Research References
use_cases.description: Export a saved document bibliography as BibTeX or RIS for an authorized research workflow.

use_cases.title: Standardize a Manuscript Style
use_cases.description: Review references and apply an explicitly requested document style change while preserving existing rich content.

prompt_templates.title: Format Saved References
prompt_templates.prompt: Format references for Citation document [DOCUMENT_ID] in APA style. Report missing metadata without changing the document.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: obtain formatted references from a saved document.

prompt_templates.title: Review Citation Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Check citations for Citation document [DOCUMENT_ID], then format references using its saved style. List unresolved fields with source IDs and preserve existing metadata.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review completeness before using a bibliography.

prompt_templates.title: Export a Bibliography
prompt_templates.prompt: Export Citation document [DOCUMENT_ID] as BibTeX to [NEW_OUTPUT_PATH]. Verify workspace and export permissions, preserve snapshot consistency, and do not share the file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: create a requested bibliography file.

prompt_templates.title: Update Style with Concurrency Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Change Citation document [DOCUMENT_ID] to chicago-author-date. Read its current version and preserve rich content. Handle conflicts and uncertain responses using the documented request-ID rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: perform an authorized document update with concurrency safeguards.

output_examples.input: Format an illustrative saved book in APA: author Maya Chen, year 2024, title Research Methods, publisher Example Press.
output_examples.output: Chen, M. (2024). Research methods. Example Press.

output_examples.input: Check an illustrative saved source S2 titled Research Notes with no author or publication date, then report unresolved fields.
output: Unresolved fields: author and publication date.
The reference remains incomplete. Source metadata was not changed.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace, document, and requested style before formatting or exporting.
Review metadata warnings and preserve exact names, titles, identifiers, punctuation, and diacritics.
Retain snapshot identifiers across pages and use version checks for explicitly requested document updates.
anti_patterns: Do not treat metadata checks as verification of the original publication.
Do not combine individually numbered in-text examples into a finished numeric bibliography.
Do not silently correct source metadata, change document styles, or share exports without appropriate authorization.

faq.question: Which citation styles are documented?
faq.answer: APA, MLA, Chicago author-date, Chicago notes-bibliography, Harvard Cite Them Right, IEEE, NLM citation-sequence, AMA, and ACS are documented.

faq.question: What happens when I do not specify a style?
faq.answer: The workflow uses the document's saved style by omitting the style flag.

faq.question: Does formatting change my draft?
faq.answer: Formatting alone does not change the draft. A document style update requires an explicit request and a current version check.

faq.question: Can it verify that a publication is accurate?
faq.answer: No. Citation checks identify saved metadata problems but cannot verify the original publication.

faq.question: Which bibliography export formats are supported?
faq.answer: The documented workflow exports BibTeX or RIS. Export requires exports:read plus document and source read permissions.

faq.question: What happens if the document changes during formatting?
faq.answer: The workflow discards partial results and restarts once from the beginning. If results change again, it reports ongoing document edits.
